, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly interpreted the search results from the first WebSurfer turn. The search results clearly showed a profile for "Sachin Warrier" at "Naviguard" (with 20+ years of experience in software testing) alongside the Co-Founder profile at "DreamPay". While the Planner noted DreamPay was his current role, it completely ignored the explicit mention of Sachin Warrier working at Naviguard in the first search result snippet ("Sachin Warrier - Naviguard | LinkedIn"). By focusing solely on DreamPay without verifying if the specific "Sachin Warrier" mentioned in the prompt corresponds to the Naviguard profile (which fits the "software engineer" description with 20+ years of experience better than a startup co-founder who might have a different name match or context), the Planner proceeded to find the headquarters of the wrong company (DreamPay in Bengaluru) instead of the correct one (Naviguard, which is headquartered in Mumbai). The error was a failure to disambiguate between multiple individuals with the same name or to fully analyze the provided search snippets before making a definitive decision.
